title: When Reasoning Is Not Enough: Proactive Inquiry for Cross-Modal Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can act unsafely when individually benign images and texts are interpreted jointly. Beyond implicit reasoning risk, where reasoning drifts toward harm, we identify intent-level risk, where cross-modal ambiguity silently commits the model to a hazardous premise that path-level optimization alone cannot correct. We propose SAFE-PRO, which uses a Risk-Conditioned Uncertainty (RCU) signal, combining predictive entropy with a learned cross-modal risk score, to decide when to ask safety-grounded clarifying questions and where to apply path optimization, under a reward that prioritizes safety and penalizes over-refusal. We also build SSUI-Dialog, a multimodal multi-turn dataset with dual-intent supervision, and theoretically analyze gradient variance and unsafe-completion risk under RCU. translated_title: 当推理并不足够：多模态大语言模型中面向跨模态安全的主动式询问
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在单独看无害的图像和文本被联合解读时，可能会做出不安全的行为。除了隐性推理风险（即推理过程滑向危害）之外，我们还识别出了意图级风险，即跨模态歧义会悄无声息地使模型陷入一个危险的前提假设，而仅靠路径级优化无法纠正这一问题。我们提出了SAFE-PRO，它利用风险条件化不确定性（RCU）信号——将预测熵与学习得到的跨模态风险评分相结合——来决定何时提出基于安全的澄清性问题，以及在何处应用路径优化，其奖励机制以安全为优先并惩罚过度拒绝。我们还构建了SSUI-Dialog，一个具有双重意图监督的多模态多轮对话数据集，并从理论上分析了RCU下的梯度方差与不安全补全风险。在七个基准测试和两个基础MLLM上的实验表明，SAFE-PRO始终比SRPO显著提升安全性，并大致将其过度拒答率降低了一半。
tldr: 论文提出SAFE-PRO方法，通过风险条件化不确定性信号，使多模态大语言模型在面临跨模态歧义时主动提出安全澄清性问题，从而在提升安全性的同时降低过度拒答。
en_tdlr: SAFE-PRO uses a Risk-Conditioned Uncertainty signal to enable multimodal LLMs to proactively ask safety-grounded clarifying questions when cross-modal ambiguity poses intent-level risks, improving safety while halving over-refusal.
